description: This file provides security utilities including password hashing, verification, and JWT token management. It includes functions for salted password hashing, password verification, JWT creation, and decoding, relying on configurations from a settings provider.

methods.name: bytes _get_salt()
methods.description: Generates a random salt of length 16 bytes.

methods.name: str _hash_password_with_salt(password: str, salt: bytes)
methods.description: Hashes a password with a given salt using PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256.

methods.name: str hash_password(password: str)
methods.description: Hashes a plaintext password, returning a salted hash string.

methods.name: bool verify_password(password: str, salted_hash: str)
methods.description: Verifies a plaintext password against a salted hash.

methods.name: str create_access_token(subject: str, extra_claims: Dict[str, Any] | None = None)
methods.description: Creates a signed JWT token for a given subject with optional extra claims.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] decode_access_token(token: str)
methods.description: Decodes and validates a JWT token, returning its payload.

ctags.name: create_access_token
ctags.pattern: /^def create_access_token(subject: str, extra_claims: Dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> str:$/
ctags.signature: (subject: str, extra_claims: Dict[str, Any] | None = None)
